entries.gap: The task required durable reviews without assigning one publication owner.
entries.headline: Preserve reasoning [REDACTED]
entries.rationale: One publication owner gives every caller the same recovery guarantee.
entries.reach: New analyzers and providers must publish through the repository boundary.
entries.scenario: A review finishes and publishes several related records. The repository writer makes the manifest visible last, so a crash cannot expose half a review. Separate writers would each need to coordinate that recovery rule.
entries.when: When durable review publication was implemented

summary.noChoiceRationale: The specification explicitly selected the observed behavior; the implementation introduced no additional undeclared decision.
